labels.name: Antibody 1
labels.note: OpenStax prints 'Antibody 1', 'Antibody 2' and 'Antibody 3' on the three lymphocytes, while its caption calls them T cells with three specificities; the drawn objects are cells whose paired receptor arms bind the epitopes, not antibodies. Covered for good and never asked.
